name: Kleinian Limit Set
desc: An Indra's-Pearls Kleinian-group limit set: two Mobius maps spin an infinite necklace of nested tangent pearls and fractal dust that breathes between a loose chain and dense self-similar froth, depth-hued and glowing on dark.

froth.doc: group closeness / trace: loose chain (low) -> dense fractal froth (high)

swirl.doc: loxodromic twist of the generators -> spiralling filigree
